title: Brazil’s new curtailment rules unlikely to revive utility-scale solar investment
summary: Brazil’s new curtailment rules offer greater regulatory certainty for solar developers, but uncertainty over future generation cuts and financial risks continues to weigh on investment. Industry experts expect new utility-scale solar projects to remain limited despite progress on compensation and curtailment allocation. The post Brazil’s new curtailment rules unlikely to revive utility-scale solar investment appeared first on pv magazine Global .
